text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of computers and machines to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence. This includes understanding language, recognizing images, solving problems, and making decisions. A key part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of following fixed rules. Deep learning, a more advanced form of machine learning, uses complex networks to recognize patterns, much like the human brain. In daily life, AI is everywhere. It powers smartphone assistants, recommends movies on streaming services, filters spam from your email, and helps doctors analyze medical images. Although AI may seem futuristic, it already helps us in many simple and practical ways.
